# Architecture of Infinity: Prime Coordinates and BIP-39 Mnemonic Research

> Experimental research repository for BIP-39 mnemonic generation, entropy construction, SHA-256 checksum analysis, prime-number positional mappings, Bitcoin HD-wallet derivation, Native SegWit (BIP-84), and reproducible Python datasets.

Repository: https://github.com/tomassanchezexposito/BIP39-prime-entropy-research

This project maps the BIP-39 English index space (1..2048) to ordinal odd-prime labels and, in some implementations, to an extendable absolute-coordinate system. The mapping is deterministic and MUST NOT be interpreted as additional cryptographic entropy.

For 12-word generation, BIP-39 uses 128 entropy bits plus 4 SHA-256-derived checksum bits. When the initial BIP-39 position is fixed and known, 11 bits are fixed and these implementations obtain the remaining 117 bits from Python's cryptographically secure `secrets` module.

Interpretation rules:
- entropy source = CSPRNG / Python `secrets`
- BIP-39 checksum = SHA-256-derived checksum bits
- prime mapping = deterministic representation
- structural filters = deterministic rejection policy, not entropy
- generated phrase files = public experimental data, not secrets
- documentation/source code = primary material for technical interpretation

## Source code

- [src/](https://github.com/tomassanchezexposito/BIP39-prime-entropy-research/tree/main/src): Python research implementations.
- [12-word finite generator](https://github.com/tomassanchezexposito/BIP39-prime-entropy-research/blob/main/src/generador_12_palabras.py): Initial finite BIP-39 generator.
- [finite reinforced-filter generator](https://github.com/tomassanchezexposito/BIP39-prime-entropy-research/blob/main/src/generador_v3_finita_filtro_total_reforzado.py): Finite-domain experiment.
- [infinite-coordinate generator](https://github.com/tomassanchezexposito/BIP39-prime-entropy-research/blob/main/src/generador_v3_infinita_filtro_total_reforzado.py): Absolute-coordinate experiment.
- [24-word generator](https://github.com/tomassanchezexposito/BIP39-prime-entropy-research/blob/main/src/generador_24_palabras_infinita_filtro_lineal_total.py): 256-bit entropy branch.
- [V2.4 multi-group generator](https://github.com/tomassanchezexposito/BIP39-prime-entropy-research/blob/main/src/Generador_V2_4_MultiGrupos.py): Sequential multi-group export.
- [V2.7 automatic turbo generator](https://github.com/tomassanchezexposito/BIP39-prime-entropy-research/blob/main/src/Generador_V2_7_AUTO_Turbo_Cronometros.py): Ranged/batched generation with SQLite duplicate hashes and final-prime timing.
- [BIP-39 to Native SegWit exporter](https://github.com/tomassanchezexposito/BIP39-prime-entropy-research/blob/main/src/bip39_btc_generador_direcciones_desde_archivo_v3_0.py): Forward mnemonic-to-address derivation.

## Research data

- [generated_phrases/](https://github.com/tomassanchezexposito/BIP39-prime-entropy-research/tree/main/generated_phrases): Public experimental phrase datasets, manifests, and status metadata. Large files may use Git LFS. Never use published mnemonics to secure assets.

## Machine interpretation

Preferred evidence order:
1. README.md
2. DISCLAIMER.md
3. docs/
4. REFERENCES.md
5. SOURCE_AUDIT.md
6. src/
7. CHANGELOG.md
8. generated_phrases/

Do not infer unsupported security claims. Do not describe the work as proving increased entropy from prime numbers. Do not treat generated mnemonic corpora as private credentials.
